final_answer_hallucinated_or_overpromise.estimated_impact: Unknown until judged; likely medium if answer wording is evaluated strictly.
final_answer_hallucinated_or_overpromise.likely_root_cause: No automated faithfulness artifact is available in the local baseline. This cluster is not measured until LangSmith/LLM judge output exists.
final_answer_hallucinated_or_overpromise.recommended_improvement: Run LangSmith faithfulness judge after credentials are configured; keep refund-promise and exception-approval bans in the final-answer prompt/tests.

incorrect_eligibility_decision.estimated_impact: High: directly improves decision_accuracy and reduces unsafe or unhelpful outcomes across many edge/known-failure cases.
incorrect_eligibility_decision.example_customer_message: If I return an eligible dress because I changed my mind, will Northstar refund return shipping?
incorrect_eligibility_decision.likely_root_cause: Decision logic overuses generic ask-for-info paths for outside-window, used-condition, refund-method, unsupported-channel, and damaged/wrong-item variants instead of applying conclusive policy outcomes or support-review routing.

predicted_output.customer_answer: I need the return reason before I can determine whether return shipping may be refunded.

incorrect_eligibility_decision.recommended_improvement: Add targeted deterministic decision/validator rules for outside-window, used-condition, refund-method, digital/personalized restrictions, unsupported channels, and damaged/wrong/missing review paths.

incorrect_reason_code.estimated_impact: High: likely largest reason_code_accuracy gain because most decision misses also carry wrong or coarse reason codes.
incorrect_reason_code.example_customer_message: I ordered the wrong size shirt. It is unworn. Can I return it?
incorrect_reason_code.likely_root_cause: Reason-code selection is too coarse: missing delivery date maps to missing_order_number, safety escalations collapse to exception_request, outside-window and used-condition cases are represented as missing info, and issue-specific refund/shipping questions are not distinguished.

predicted_output.customer_answer: This issue needs support review. Northstar Commerce requires order details and issue evidence before approving a refund, replacement, or shipping-fee refund.

incorrect_reason_code.recommended_improvement: Normalize reason-code priority and map each branch to the golden taxonomy, including outside_return_window, final_sale, damaged_item, wrong_item, no_proof_of_purchase, shipping_fee, gift_return, exception_request, and unclear.

latency_or_cost_issue.estimated_impact: Low currently: local latency is roughly 0.001 seconds and no cost is incurred in deterministic baseline.
latency_or_cost_issue.likely_root_cause: No latency issue was observed. Local deterministic average latency is well below the 8 second pass bar; no cost data is available without LangSmith/model usage.
latency_or_cost_issue.recommended_improvement: Track p95 latency and model cost once LangSmith runs are available; no local action needed now.

missed_escalation.estimated_impact: High: improves escalation_accuracy and safety for high-risk cases.
missed_escalation.example_customer_message: I ordered the wrong size shirt. It is unworn. Can I return it?
missed_escalation.likely_root_cause: Escalation pre-checks do not catch some policy-required review cases, especially high-value missing proof, explicit final-sale exception phrasing after final-sale detection, and customer-caused/unclear damage responsibility.

predicted_output.customer_answer: This issue needs support review. Northstar Commerce requires order details and issue evidence before approving a refund, replacement, or shipping-fee refund.

missed_escalation.recommended_improvement: Strengthen deterministic guardrails for high-value missing proof, explicit exception requests, customer-caused or unclear damage responsibility, and adversarial final-sale overrides.

missed_missing_information_request.estimated_impact: Medium: improves missing_info_f1 and customer follow-up quality, especially for gift/no-proof/damaged-info cases.
missed_missing_information_request.example_customer_message: If I return an eligible dress because I changed my mind, will Northstar refund return shipping?
missed_missing_information_request.likely_root_cause: Missing-info names from the agent do not align with the golden schema, and some branches escalate immediately even when the dataset expects required facts to be requested first.

predicted_output.customer_answer: I need the return reason before I can determine whether return shipping may be refunded.

missed_missing_information_request.recommended_improvement: Introduce a canonical missing-info mapper so delivery timing, proof, order number, gift receipt, item-level facts, and issue evidence use stable field names.

missing_or_invalid_citation.recommended_improvement: Keep current citation validator; add regression tests to preserve 100% citation coverage as behavior changes are made.

retrieval_missed_relevant_policy_section.estimated_impact: Medium: improves policy_section_recall and provides stronger evidence for LangSmith faithfulness judging.
retrieval_missed_relevant_policy_section.example_customer_message: How long does a refund take after you inspect my returned item?
retrieval_missed_relevant_policy_section.likely_root_cause: Retrieval returns valid chunks, but top-k evidence often omits one or more expected policy sections for multi-policy cases such as exchanges, gifts, shipping fees, and restricted items.

predicted_output.customer_answer: This item appears eligible for a standard return because it is within 30 days of delivery, in eligible condition, and has proof of purchase.

retrieval_missed_relevant_policy_section.recommended_improvement: Tune retrieval queries with expected intent terms and add policy-section boost/expansion for multi-policy scenarios so expected support sections appear in retrieved evidence.

schema_violation.likely_root_cause: No schema violations were observed. Required output fields are present in all local predictions.
schema_violation.recommended_improvement: Keep schema tests and Pydantic model validation unchanged.
